About

Reliance was founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and is now promoted and managed by his elder son, Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani. Ambani's family has about 50% shareholding in the conglomerate.

Key Points

Architecture
Reliance Industries Limited holds key business stakes, including 66.43% in Jio Platforms (RJIL). Additionally, it maintains an 83.56% ownership each in Reliance Retail Ventures and Reliance Consumer Products, alongside a 59.59% holding in JioStar.[1]
